title: Credit Limit Reviews — Commercial Credit Account Credit Policy
content:
Limit reviews on a Commercial Credit Account are taken only on accounts whose status is active.

### Clauses

1. A permanent increase request is decided only when at least the tier's minimum number of calendar months since review have passed since the account's last credit review date.
2. Add the months to the last review date by calendar month; when the target month has no such day the boundary is the last day of that month, and a request dated on the boundary is decided.
3. *Retired, no longer in force:* "A permanent increase is approved when the account's trailing twelve-month on-time payment percentage is at least the tier's minimum on-time percentage for limit increases; the approved limit is the requested limit capped at the current limit increased by the tier's largest permanent step percentage and at the tier's credit limit ceiling, decided approved when nothing is capped and approved at a reduced limit when a cap applies." This clause has been superseded by the current basis.
4. When the increase granted (approved limit minus current limit) exceeds the tier's desk approval amount the request is decided referred to committee with approved limit 0.00 and the limit is unchanged.
5. A temporary increase for a shutdown, turnaround or seasonal build is granted up to the tier's largest temporary increase percent of the permanent limit for at most the tier's longest temporary increase in days from the decision date, needs no minimum interval since the last review, and reverts automatically the day after its expiry date; a tier whose largest temporary increase is 0 does not offer it.
6. Every request is decided within the tier's limit review decision period in business days.
7. An approved decision updates the account's limit and makes the decision date the account's last credit review date; a declined or referred decision changes neither.

### The trailing twelve-month on-time payment percentage

Of the invoices whose due date falls in the 12 calendar months ending on the current date, the percentage, rounded down to a whole number, whose balance was reduced to zero by payments, discounts and credit memos dated on or before the due date; an account with no such invoice counts as 100.

### Review interval boundary (hypothetical, 6-month minimum)

| Last credit review date | Boundary | Request dated on the boundary | Request dated the day before |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 January | 15 July | decided | not decided |
| 31 August | 28 February (29 February in a leap year) | decided | not decided |

*Temporary increase, hypothetical:* on a tier allowing 15 percent for 30 days, a permanent limit of 40000.00 can be raised temporarily by up to 6000.00 for at most 30 days from the decision date, and it reverts the day after its expiry date.

superseded_clauses: A permanent increase is approved when credit_msr_on_time_pct_12m is at least limit_increase_min_on_time_pct; the approved limit is the requested limit capped at the current limit increased by limit_increase_max_step_pct percent and at the tier's credit_limit_ceiling_usd, decided approved when nothing is capped and approved_reduced when a cap applies.
